messages:
zoe: quick sync: i'm assembling a short 'regional failover + provisioning orchestration' notes page for Dedicated. aim is one compact checklist, an orchestration TF/terragrunt hint, a tiny canary toggle example, and a couple of troubleshooting one-liners.

arpit: nice. pls include a note about tenant-affinity labels and a snippet to detect mislabels. customers have had traffic go to the wrong shard when label casing differs.

zoe: adding a check step: `rwdctl tenant check-affinity --tenant T-77` and a note: labels are normalized to lowercase. call that out.

mel: for the migration hint, can you show a terragrunt wrapper that injects the new autoscale enum if legacy is detected? something small that teams can drop in their live infra repo.

zoe: draft terragrunt hook (pseudo):
```hcl
# terragrunt.hcl hook: detect legacy scale enums and map to current
locals {
  raw = read_file(find_in_parent_folders("pool.tf"))
  has_legacy = contains(local.raw, "scale_policy = \"legacy\"")
}
if local.has_legacy {
  # run helper script to rewrite enums before apply
  run_cmd("./scripts/tf-migrate-autoscale.sh")
}
```

sam: callout: include a tiny canary toggle example for routing so ops can flip small percentage of traffic to reserved pools during migration. even 5% helps validate latency/SLA deltas.

zoe: canary routing snippet (yaml):
```yaml
# canary routing example (fractional traffic to reserved)
routing:
  reserved_percent: 5
  fallback: shared
```

arpit: add a rollback CLI for reducers: `rwdctl reserved rollback --tenant T-77 --to-tag v1` — we often need an explicit quick rollback command in docs.

zoe: added rollback note and a suggested smoke test after canary: 1) run health probes, 2) run perf sample, 3) check `console.metrics` for p50/p95 deltas.

mel: troubleshooting bullets please: mismatched labels (case), quota throttles in target region, KMS deny for provisioning agent, and terraform plan rejects due to enum mismatch. keep them one-line each.

zoe: done. also adding a short paragraph: "SLA impact: routing a slice or whole tenant to reserved pools may change latency SLOs. Always notify CSM and update runbooks."

sam: tiny SDK snippet request: Go one-liner that requests a canary routing header at request-time. useful for experiments.

zoe: go snippet: 
```go
// request-time canary hint
res, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{
  Model: "redwood-dedicated/gpt-dedicated-v1",
  Input: "hi",
  Metadata: map[string]string{"routing-canary": "5%"},
})
```

doc-bot: PR opened by zoe: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/docs/+/5088 :eyes:

arpit: i'll review the terragrunt hook and canary wording. focus on clarity for ops folks.

zoe: thanks  i'll merge after editorial pass and linter, ping when live. :shipit:
